_changelog.1.1: Ex-ante extension (2026-06, before any T9 full_statistical proof run): added the negative_accumulation class (4 smooth, monotone, non-bifurcating accumulation controls) and the accumulation_specificity sub-block with accumulation_fpr_max. Rationale: ORI-C's order variable is an integrator C(t+1)=C(t)+βS−γV, so any monotone driver yields a growing self-reinforcing C; the original 6 negatives (white/pink/red noise, random walk, sinusoid, Poisson, chaotic map) are all stationary/oscillatory/chaotic and cannot separate a transition detector from a trend detector. See 02_Protocol/PREREG_ADDENDUM_2026-06_ACCUMULATION_SURROGATE.md.

accumulation_specificity._note: 8-feature classifier false-positive rate on the smooth non-bifurcating accumulation controls. The bare ΔC detector firing rate on the same controls is reported separately as accumulation_bare_detector_fpr (diagnostic, not a gate).
